title: Gilas’ Asian Games struggles highlight player availability issue anew

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines– Gilas Pilipinas’ campaign in the Asian Games again exposed a problem that has followed the national team through the years: the availability of Filipino players based abroad. Without the team’s mainstays and naturalized star Justin Brownlee, the Nationals went with an all-PBA roster with a lone holdover from the gold medal run in Hangzhou to defend their title in the men’s 5-on-5 basketball Asian Games. The Philippines placed ninth, its worst finish in Asian Games history after failing to advance from the group stage with a 1-2 record.
